description:
The browser replaces the issue-list metadata source with unfiltered graph summaries.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Change events no longer request /issues; full unfiltered graph summaries provide labels and dependency titles even when graph filters hide nodes. Remove `listIssues` and its test with the final App caller, after the search scorer has been replaced.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests cover filtered dependencies and refresh.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.
title: Use unfiltered graph summaries for browser metadata
